'''Renk Narviz''' was a [[human]] [[Resistance pilot|pilot]] who served the [[Resistance]] during their [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[First Order]]. One of many new recruits, Narviz was stationed at the Resistance [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|base]] on [[Ajan Kloss]].<ref name="TROS VD" />
